slides.name: hook
slides.head:
इस दिवाली फिर वही सवाल?
शादी कब? सेटल कब?
slides.sub: What if this year you chose you?

slides.name: card
slides.title: The Star
slides.sub: The card of hope after a long wait.

slides.name: stars
slides.label: LOOK CLOSER
slides.head:
One bright star.
Seven smaller ones around it.
slides.sub:
Your light and theirs can both shine.
Neither has to dim.

slides.name: message
slides.quote: लोग कहते रहेंगे। इस बार अपनी सुनो।
slides.trans: People will keep talking. This time, listen to yourself.
